behaviors.description: Filter controlled service through system-bus policies.
behaviors.preconditions: Private daemon address supplied as system bus, independent echo service and host client.
behaviors.expected: Default denial, run/stored system-talk reply, run/stored system-no-talk denial.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke unfiltered controlled system bus.
behaviors.preconditions: Private daemon address supplied as system bus with echo service.
behaviors.expected: Socket grants permit otherwise denied service; run/stored socket revocation restores denial.

behaviors.description: Enable filtered session bus in restrictive mode and disable it explicitly.
behaviors.preconditions: Private echo service and host client.
behaviors.expected: Sandbox with session-bus and talk grant gets reply; no-session-bus removes connection.

behaviors.description: Allow a controlled service through filtered session bus.
behaviors.preconditions: Private echo service and independent host dbus-send tool exposed through host-os files only.
behaviors.expected: Default destination denied; run and stored talk grants get replies; stored denial blocks again.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke unfiltered private session bus socket.
behaviors.preconditions: Private echo service and independent host client.
behaviors.expected: Default filtered bus denies service; session-bus grants allow replies; nosocket restores filtering.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke a controlled Wayland socket path.
behaviors.preconditions: Bound dummy Unix socket selected through WAYLAND_DISPLAY.
behaviors.expected: Path absent by default, present with run/stored grant, absent with run/stored denial.

behaviors.description: Expose and revoke a controlled SSH authentication socket path.
behaviors.preconditions: Bound dummy Unix socket selected through SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
behaviors.expected: Path absent by default, present with run/stored grant, absent with run/stored denial.

behaviors.preconditions: Bound dummy Wayland socket and conditional permission support.
behaviors.expected: Socket visible only with true condition.
